explanation: The hypothesis closely reconstructs the target material, replacement of EAM/TI by MTP/FEP, DFT conditions, phase-space rationale, electronic and SRO contributions, performance targets, baseline, and benchmark validation. The falsification test is quantitative and decisive, although deviation of the electronic-excitation shift would challenge that physical contribution more directly than the core MTP-FEP methodology. Boundary coverage is good but frames applicability somewhat narrowly and does not fully discuss transferability across the entire high-entropy-alloy family. Evidence validity is limited because no supporting evidence or citations are supplied despite the request for prior evidence. Also, describing 80% resource savings as a roughly 20-fold speedup is arithmetically ambiguous unless the metrics refer to different computational components.
